headline: Hagidong House 2 / Hyunjoon Yoo + Partners
context: Hagidong House 2 sits firmly on the land of a gradual slope in Hagi-dong, Daejeon City. The main design concept of the house was to provide privacy for a family of four and was developed from the idea of Hanok, traditional Korean architecture.
